verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence says Paystack runs 'automated and manual fraud systems' that protect merchants. That is vendor-managed fraud protection. Nothing shows a user-visible machine-learning fraud score per transaction, or any way for finance-ops users to write custom block, review, or allow rules. This adjacent capability earns no credit toward the story.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can screen transactions with machine-learning fraud scores and write custom block, review, and allow rules
